name: Pacific & Indian cyclones
summary: Severe Cyclone Murasu due to hit south Andhra Pradesh overnight 2–3 Nov; GDACS now green
state: GDACS lowered Cyclone Murasu to a green alert on 2 Nov, below its earlier red. India's Meteorological Department expects the severe cyclonic storm to cross the south Andhra Pradesh coast near Ongole between 23:30 on 2 Nov and 04:00 on 3 Nov local time, with winds of 100–110km/h gusting to 120km/h and a 1–1.5m storm surge. Schools are closed in parts of Andhra Pradesh, Odisha and Tamil Nadu.
for_you: People in or travelling to coastal Andhra Pradesh, north Tamil Nadu and southern Odisha should follow India Meteorological Department warnings and local authority instructions. Check FCDO travel advice for India.

why: Typhoons and cyclones are the deadliest weather events, threatening densely populated coasts in Asia and the Indian Ocean.
drivers: Ocean heat, ENSO phase, season (W Pacific peaks Jul–Oct; N Indian Apr–Jun & Oct–Dec).

rubric.alert: GDACS red cyclone alert, or a super-typhoon/severe cyclone landfall on a populated coast.
rubric.watch: GDACS orange cyclone alert, or a typhoon/cyclone threatening land within 72h.
rubric.normal: No GDACS orange/red tropical cyclone alerts.
